description: Source code for bot navigation mesh loading, saving, and management in a game, including functions for handling off-mesh connections, loading navmesh data, and initializing navigation data structures.

methods.name: FailAssertion
methods.description: Custom assertion failure handler for debug builds.

methods.name: BotAssertionInit
methods.description: Initializes custom assertion handlers for debug builds.

methods.name: BotSaveOffMeshConnections
methods.description: Saves off-mesh navigation connections to a file.

methods.name: BotLoadOffMeshConnections
methods.description: Loads off-mesh navigation connections from a file.

methods.name: BotLoadNavMesh
methods.description: Loads a navigation mesh from a file, including tiles and off-mesh connections.

methods.name: G_BotShutdownNav
methods.description: Shuts down and frees all navigation mesh data.

methods.name: G_BotSetupNav
methods.description: Sets up navigation mesh for a given species, loading from file and initializing query structures.
